input: X11 buttons, motion and Shift through XTEST, --ozone-platform=x11; touch through CDP
page: one position:fixed target filling the viewport; capture-phase window listeners log each event at the target; contextmenu and middle mousedown are cancelled so no menu or autoscroll opens
units: mouse steps in device pixels from the start point; touch steps in CSS pixels from the viewport centre; sleep-limit is the double-click time plus the offset in ms
